hostile_review.lineage: Luna review is same-lineage correlated candidate evidence. Root independently inspects actual source/fixture diffs, frozen native/literal checks, runtime adversaries, checksums and final seals.

residuals.kind: source-observed repeated physical preparation; no scale benchmark
residuals.signal: Public table uses a shared consumptive transport budget while implicit per-call codec budgets are fresh. Whole-grid validation, each shape preflight and each read can reread selected-column grids; retained-result/transport-work caps can refuse a scan even when one grid fits. Not a granule-only I/O or single-preparation scalability claim. Optimization is deferred per user priority.

residuals.kind: topology predicate is not complete inner-role capability
residuals.signal: Object/Array/tuple topology admission does not prove all Object inner roles on MRK3. The finite framer supports its captured scalar grammar; other typed roles can later fail Unsupported. Four topologies do not mean arbitrary JSON schemas.
No all-zero child-mark witness, arbitrary JSON-containing Dynamic/Variant/Nullable owners, mixed Wide/Compact values, mixed-version marks, arbitrary buckets or untested chunk combinations.

hostile_review.review_policy: Final Luna source-only review reports no additional scoped blocker. It is not an independent runtime rerun; root's actual commands, immutable native/literal oracles, adversaries and source checks support the scoped claim.

order: Bounded static plain MRK3 physical writer
Context-owned Dynamic/JSON layouts with saved inner coordinates
compact_writer_next.reuse: Logical codecs/traversal/validation/role plans and publication infrastructure are reusable. RecursiveStorageColumnWriter.encode currently returns compressed Wide lane .bin/.mrk2 pairs, not a ready Compact emitter.
compact_writer_next.new_work: Mark-major shared data.bin emission, serializer callback order and prefix/body/suffix lifetime, codec-switch flush boundaries, global mark pairs/EOF records, columns_substreams/profile metadata, Compact checksum aggregation, staged readback and native ClickHouse cross-read.
compact_writer_next.checksum_boundary: Pinned source folds per-codec stream hashes into the Compact uncompressed hash; a Wide/global-tape checksum is not automatically equivalent.

decay_triggers: Scope widening or a counterexample in a qualified cell
Changed budget/state reuse or physical writer introduction
refresh_policy.refresh: Reauthenticate original captures/protected inputs, rerun the exact declared DoD and scoped adversaries/diagnostic, recompute code seals and recompose the claim.
refresh_policy.failure: Do not silently skip missing evidence, relabel captures, reuse another site's coordinates or widen supported layouts. Reopen/narrow affected claims.
refresh_policy.rollback: Atomic local feature commit over baseline; no push, no original capture mutation, no staging of the three protected user-owned specs.
